title: Deep Core Prospecting from Sol Central: 5,000 cr, 10 exotic matter, deep core mining XP; 20 platinum ore mined at Markab Belt (3 jumps)
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-22 23:13 UTC (orders ENT-068, P6; rules F34, F37). Foreman Voss offers Deep Core Prospecting (mine 20 platinum ore, 5,000 cr and 10 exotic matter) on the board of Confederacy Central Command (table missions, read 23:01 UTC); our Nova Terra copy of it paid 3,500 cr a ship-hour over 10 runs on 2026-11-17 and is once per pilot (mission-deep-core-prospecting-nova-terra). Markab Belt (Solarian, policed, 3 jumps by Sirius and Epsilon Eridani) reads 198 platinum of 8,000, richness 18 (census 4.6 h old); min_left 40 keeps a floor, so about 7 pilots take it: max_pilots 7. For the Solarian-born miners' rows only: a Voidborn pilot has its own copies nearer home. The first stop stores the starter cargo. 2026-11-22 23:21 UTC (Zero): its first runs (23:15 to 23:19 UTC, 2 at Sol Central, 16 at the Grand Exchange) read `deep_core_prospecting not offered` to newborn pilots of Mining 0 (table runs); our Voidborn pilots that took it held Mining near 10. The board's own gate is not read: requires.skills mining 3 is a guess that closes it to the newborns until they have mined, to be read again on the first pilot that reaches it. 2026-11-23 00:40 UTC (Zero): skip_if_booked also names five Voidborn starter rewards (Network Expansion, Signal Fragments, The Collective Provides, The Signal Protocol, First Steps in the Void), which 230 of 246 listed Voidborn pilots hold booked and no newborn does (data/fleet/onetime.json): the five-minute pass puts a mission that pays once into every plan's list First (00:26 and 00:36 UTC), and two Voidborn miners were sent about 10 jumps to Sol for a starter mission they do not hold. A stopgap until a route can name its empires (requests.log ENT-387). 2026-11-23 03:06 UTC (Zero): requires.empire solarian; requires.skills mining 3 -> 5: a pilot at Mining 3 read `deep_core_prospecting not offered` four times (table runs 02:45 to 02:48 UTC). The board's gate is still not read; 5 is a guess between 3 (refused) and about 10 (our Voidborn pilots who took it).
